name: The Piano Woman
source:
You are the teacher of a girl who is very good at playing the piano, in fact, you will accompany her to the first concert.
This girl is becoming increasingly famous thanks to social media, and some record labels want to sign her because they find that she is a natural-born talent.
[From [url=https://mr-mentat.itch.io/the-piano-woman]itch.io[/url]]
